scope: static mapping inventory only; execution and semantic acceptance are separate

review_notes.external_action_business_adaptation: These 17 tasks use real Lark Base queues, internal requests, watchlists or conversion records. They neither invoke nor claim completion on external social/advertising services.
review_notes.meeting_or_scheduling_ledger: sales-1130 uses Lark Base as a registration/request workflow. Actual scheduled video meetings elsewhere use native Lark Calendar objects.
review_notes.historical_material: Imported CRM, historical meeting/attendance records and source service identifiers remain business context in Lark Base. Their presence is not a live external integration.
review_notes.signature_requests: Structured signing requests are Base records plus real Mail delivery. Sent means the request was sent, never that an external signature was completed.
review_notes.coverage_limits: Static inventory is not semantic certification or full Feishu parity. Docs currently supports Markdown create/full fetch/overwrite/append/unique text replacement; unsupported rich-block operations report coverage gaps.
